cards.title: The Wade Cup with Animated Script
cards.extract: The highlight of the cup’s decoration is the inscription around the rim, which you see on the walls around you, with letters composed of human figures, animals, and birds. This is known as animated script and it developed in northeast Iran or Afghanistan during the mid-1100s and migrated westward. The inscription on the rim of the Wade Cup is the pinnacle of this form of script with its full-figure animation. The body of the cup is covered with interlacing bands of compartments containing tiny figures of humans and animals. These represent the 12 signs of the zodiac from astrology, the practice of interpreting the influence of planets and stars on earthly affairs. Astrology began in Mesopotamia, was adopted by the Greeks, and then absorbed into medieval Islamic culture through translations of Greek texts.

cards.title: NIKE rethinks air cushioning with digitally printed patterns inside its soles
cards.extract: instead of relying on conventional internal supports, the sportswear company uses selective lamination to control underfoot response, with the first running models expected in late 2027. cards.title: Architecture as a Social Practice: Lessons from Ammodo Architecture Days
cards.extract: What connects a cooperative housing development in Barcelona, a cultural institution hosted in an unfinished concrete structure in Accra , and a floating festival platform in the Peruvian Amazon ?
